reports.name: Child Welfare Agency Report
reports.guidance: Select a distinct report or written update prepared by, or expressly presented as the report of, the child welfare agency responsible for the dependency case, for the juvenile court's consideration. Use the document's own title on its cover/first page as the name. Child Welfare Agency Report is only the fallback when the document clearly qualifies but no title is discernible; it is not a required literal heading. The document's title need not contain report. Memoranda, letters, addenda, supplemental information, and other agency updates qualify when they serve this function, including short memoranda explaining or supplying omitted material; substantial narrative or a recommendation is not required. Determine agency identity and report purpose from the visible evidence on the supplied first page: agency letterhead or department identification; attribution to a child welfare social worker, supervisor, or authorized agency representative; an addressee or introductory statement directing the document to the juvenile court; and case-specific information, assessments, recommendations, or explanations submitted to inform the court. These are supporting clues, not mandatory fields or an exhaustive checklist. Agency names and report titles vary by jurisdiction; no particular agency name, worker abbreviation, title, or form code is required. Do not select a document merely because it mentions the agency, bears a filing stamp, was transmitted or filed by the agency, or appears among its attachments. Distinguish the agency's report from independently authored CASA, medical, psychological, school, service-provider, or law-enforcement records, and from petitions, motions, notices, proofs of service, and court orders. An independent attachment does not become the agency's own report merely through submission. Exclude child welfare case plans, including documents entitled CHILD WELFARE SERVICES CASE PLAN, and their updated or amended versions. These are case-planning documents or report attachments, not qualifying reports or written updates, even when prepared by the agency, submitted to the court, or presented with their own title and date. For a case plan, return an empty name and an empty rule_id; do not use the fallback report name. This exclusion does not disqualify an otherwise qualifying agency report merely because it discusses or attaches a case plan. Keep each distinct qualifying report's own title; do not merge separate reports because their names or dates match. If agency identity or court-directed report purpose is unclear, leave the name empty rather than guessing.
